items.title: Nigeria's central bank could cut rates by 600bp by end-2027 as inflation heads below 10% - Capital Economics
items.summary: Nigeria's inflation should fall below 10% by mid-2027, making room for 600 basis points of rate cuts by end-2027, Capital Economics said in a note on November 17. The London-based consultancy expects the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) to cut its monetary policy rate by 150bp to 21.
